Resolutions of 1948

29 resolutions, 31% unanimous. Founding and early Cold War.

  • 38 (1948) Requesting India and Pakistan to take measures to improve the situation in Kashmir
  • 39 (1948) Establishing a Commission on the India-Pakistan question
  • 40 (1948) Political developments in western Java and Madura, Indonesia
  • 41 (1948) The signing of the Truce Agreement by the Netherlands and Indonesia
  • 42 (1948) Implementation of General Assembly resolution 181 (II) on the question of Palestine
  • 43 (1948) Calling for an immediate truce in Palestine
  • 44 (1948) Requesting a special session of the General Assembly to discuss the future government of Palestine
  • 45 (1948) Admission of Burma (Myanmar) to membership in the United Nations
  • 46 (1948) Calling upon all parties to take immediate measures for a truce in Palestine
  • 47 (1948) Restoration of peace and order and the plebiscite in the State of Jammu and Kashmir
  • 48 (1948) Establishment of the UN Truce Commission for Palestine
  • 49 (1948) Calling for a cease-fire and maintenance of the truce in Jerusalem
  • 50 (1948) Calling for a cessation of hostilities in Palestine
  • 51 (1948) Directing the UN Commission for India and Pakistan to proceed without delay to the areas of dispute
  • 52 (1948) International control of atomic energy
  • 53 (1948) Appealing to all parties for prolongation of the truce in Palestine
  • 54 (1948) Calling on all Governments and authorities to cooperate with the Mediator to maintain peace in Palestine
  • 55 (1948) Calling upon the Netherlands and Indonesia to maintain strict observance of the Renville Truce Agreement
  • 56 (1948) The situation in Jerusalem
  • 57 (1948) The death of the UN Mediator in Palestine, Count Folke Bernadotte
  • 58 (1948) Conditions under which a party to the Statute of the International Court of Justice that is not a Member of the UN may participate in electing Members of the International Court of Justice
  • 59 (1948) Investigation of the assassination of the UN Mediator in Palestine
  • 60 (1948) Establishment of a subcommittee to consider amendments and revisions to the revised draft resolution contained in document S/1059/Rev.2 on the question of Palestine
  • 61 (1948) Calling upon interested Governments to withdraw forces that advanced beyond positions held on 14 Oct. 1948 and to establish truce lines and demilitarized zones
  • 62 (1948) An armistice in all sectors of Palestine
  • 63 (1948) Calling for the release of the President of Indonesia and of other political prisoners
  • 64 (1948) Calling for the release of the President of Indonesia and of other political prisoners
  • 65 (1948) Requesting consular representatives in Batavia to send a report on the situation in Indonesia
  • 66 (1948) Calling for an immediate cease-fire and facilitation of the supervision of the truce in Palestine
